boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-cost activities at Hillsdale College, from public lectures and discussions to concerts, theater, exhibitions, and an arboretum program.

cards.title: Follow the Fall-Treasure Trail
cards.subtitle: A free seasonal program at Slayton Arboretum
cards.notes: Meet at the Barber Drive entrance, hike the trails, and join the scheduled craft; check the program page before planning a visit.
cards.short_summary: A guided autumn outing combining a trail walk, nature search, bulb planting, and take-home craft.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale College identifies Autumn in the Arb as an all-ages Slayton Arboretum program with a listed cost of free; donations are welcomed rather than required.
cards.access_notes: Open to adults and children; children must be accompanied by an adult. Attend only when the program is scheduled.

cards.entity_name: Classical Liberal Organization Presentations and Discussions
cards.title: Join a Civil Campus Discussion
cards.subtitle: Public presentations, films, and conversations about liberty
cards.notes: Check the organization’s current contact information, then attend a listed presentation, film showing, or informal discussion.
cards.short_summary: A public forum for examining individual liberty, free markets, technology, and limited government.
cards.evidence_claim: The college states that the Classical Liberal Organization hosts presentations, discussions, and film showings that are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public when an activity is scheduled; contact the listed student or faculty representative for current details.

cards.title: Reserve a Seat for a CCA Lecture
cards.subtitle: Free public talks by visiting scholars and commentators
cards.notes: Choose a seminar topic, reserve as required, and arrive with time to find the announced campus lecture room.
cards.short_summary: A recurring lecture series spanning history, public affairs, culture, economics, and related subjects.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale College says all Center for Constructive Alternatives lectures are free and open to the public, although reservations are required.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public with an advance reservation; consult the current CCA seminar listing for dates and locations.

cards.title: Walk Through a Student Art Exhibit
cards.subtitle: Free exhibitions inside the Fine Arts Building
cards.notes: Check the gallery schedule, then compare works across drawing, painting, sculpture, photography, and graphic design.
cards.short_summary: A changing gallery display that turns a short campus break into a focused art-viewing session.
cards.evidence_claim: An April 2026 college release identifies three student exhibitions in Daughtrey Art Gallery and states that the exhibits and opening receptions were free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Hillsdale College Displays Senior Art Exhibits
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during announced exhibition dates and gallery hours; confirm the current exhibit before visiting.

cards.entity_name: College Choir and Chamber Choir Concerts
cards.title: Hear the Choirs in Christ Chapel
cards.subtitle: No-ticket choral performances on campus
cards.notes: Watch the fine-arts calendar for the next choir program, then meet beneath Christ Chapel’s prominent interior dome.
cards.short_summary: A shared listening outing centered on the College Choir and Chamber Choir’s varied repertoire.
cards.evidence_claim: The college’s April 2026 fine-arts release listed a College Choir and Chamber Choir concert at Christ Chapel with free admission and no ticket requirement.
cards.source_title: Hillsdale College Announces April Fine Arts Events
cards.access_notes: Open to the public for announced concerts. This documented concert required no ticket; verify the next program’s details.

cards.title: Catch a Free Stage Production
cards.subtitle: Ticketed and unticketed theater in the Fine Arts Building
cards.notes: Pick a performance date from the fine-arts calendar and reserve promptly when the listing calls for a free ticket.
cards.short_summary: An evening or matinee centered on a fully staged campus or visiting-company production.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale College’s April 2026 release listed “Pilgrim the Musical” at Markel Auditorium with free admission, while requiring ticket reservations.
cards.source_title: Hillsdale College Announces April Fine Arts Events
cards.access_notes: Open to the public for listed performances; admission is free, but some productions require advance ticket reservations.

cards.title: Settle In for a Big Band Set
cards.subtitle: Free jazz performances in Plaster Auditorium
cards.notes: Find the next Big Band date, coordinate seats with friends, and arrive before the announced start at Searle Center.
cards.short_summary: A social concert outing built around the college ensemble’s jazz and big-band repertoire.
cards.evidence_claim: The April 2026 college fine-arts release listed a Hillsdale College Big Band concert in Plaster Auditorium under a program of events declared free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Hillsdale College Announces April Fine Arts Events
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during scheduled fine-arts events; consult the current listing for any free reservation requirement.

cards.title: Observe a Visiting-Artist Masterclass
cards.subtitle: Watch musicians coach Hillsdale students in public
cards.notes: Look for a visiting-artist masterclass, sit quietly during instruction, and save discussion for the announced breaks.
cards.short_summary: A close-range look at musical interpretation, technique, and live coaching rather than a formal concert.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale College’s March 2026 release invited everyone to watch and learn at Freda Herseth’s student voice masterclass; the release states its fine-arts events are free and public.
cards.source_title: Hillsdale College March 2026 Fine Arts Events
cards.access_notes: Public access applies when a masterclass is announced; check the current fine-arts schedule for room and session times.

cards.title: Meet Up for a Faculty Recital
cards.subtitle: Free chamber performances in Howard Music Building
cards.notes: Choose a recital from the fine-arts calendar and arrive together early enough to take nearby seats in the hall.
cards.short_summary: An intimate concert format featuring college faculty in solo or small-ensemble repertoire.
cards.evidence_claim: The college’s 2025–2026 fine-arts announcement lists a faculty recital in Conrad Recital Hall and states that all listed events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Hillsdale College Announces August and September Fine Arts Events
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during scheduled recitals; check the current calendar because programs and reservation rules vary.

cards.title: Listen at Choral Evensong
cards.subtitle: Scripture, prayers, and choral anthems in the Hoynak Room
cards.notes: Check for the next service, meet in the Dow Center’s Hoynak Room, and follow the quiet ceremonial format.
cards.short_summary: A contemplative gathering shaped by choral music, spoken Scripture, and traditional prayers.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale College’s April 2026 fine-arts announcement lists Choral Evensong in the Hoynak Room and states that the month’s fine-arts events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Hillsdale College Announces April Fine Arts Events
cards.access_notes: Open to the public when listed on the fine-arts calendar; verify the next service date and room before attending.
